laptop-qwen3.5-2b.about: The laptop's writer: Qwen3.5-2B (Q4_K_M, 1.3 GB), reading 1500 characters of each piece. Its notes are the same on a CPU and a GPU; written here on the GPU, timed on 4 CPU threads apart (docs/notes.md).

laptop-qwen3-4b.about: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (Q4_K_M, 2.5 GB), reading 1500 characters of each piece; written on the GPU, timed on 4 CPU threads apart.

beefy-qwen3.5-9b.about: The beefy writer: Qwen3.5-9B (Q4_K_M, 5.7 GB) on a GPU, reading 3000 characters of each piece. Measured here with 22 of its layers on the GPU, the rest on the CPU (the GPUs ran other work): a card with room is faster.

cloud-haiku.about: The cloud writer: Claude Haiku 5.5, the key in $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, reading 3000 characters of each piece. Price: dollars a million tokens.
